## Submission instructions

Ranking will be based on the best RMSE of a team's submissions.
The `submitting.parquet` file is a template for submissions, i.e.
you need to fill the `TAXITIME_SEC_mvt` for the relevant `MVT_ID_mvt`.

Each team will have to submit its predictions in its own bucket, with a
file name template as follows

> `<team-name>_v<incremental integer>.parquet`  

We require each row to match `MVT_ID_mvt` before
`TAXITIME_SEC_mvt` will be considered by the ranking script when calculating
the RMSE.  
Errors will be issued in case of mismatch.  
Errors will also be issued in case of missing or extra rows.
